style.vernacular: Small Franco-Swedish Caribbean harbour town: one to two storey masonry and timber houses in whitewash and pastel render with red or grey painted metal and tile roofs, wooden galleries and fretwork balconies, stone-based warehouses on the quays, a dry hilly scrub island with palms and sea-grape.
style.ornament: Wooden verandas (varangues) and fretwork balconies on Swedish-era houses, red-painted roofs, stone ground floors with timber upper storeys, shuttered windows, 18th-century harbour batteries and a stone-and-timber Swedish clock tower.

sources.what: little of Swedish past survives apart from wooden houses with worked balconies and varangues; Swedish clock tower stone and timber
three harbour forts, 1829 Catholic church, 1855 Anglican church, 1961 concrete lighthouse
